description: This file defines models, constants, enums, interfaces, and classes related to segmented button widget styling and behavior in a UI framework, including appearance settings, layout options, CSS generation, and state management.

classes.name: ButtonToggleStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Abstract class for generating CSS for different button toggle states, with subclasses for enabled, hovered, and disabled states.

methods.name: generateStateCss
methods.description: Generates CSS rules for a specific toggle state based on selected and unselected appearance styles.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Retrieves color properties for a given appearance, considering custom style overrides.

methods.name: getMainColor
methods.description: Returns the main color from appearance or default.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Returns the background color from appearance or default.

methods.name: getBorderColor
methods.description: Returns the border color, defaulting to a predefined value.
